name: DOCVAT-build v1 (sidecar)
description: Build + deploy Documentos Vaticanos → https://docvat.codice-progressio.online (web + APK + Electron Linux/Windows downloads)

nodes.name: No es una referencia de tag

parameters.text: ={{ "🚀 Build Documentos Vaticanos iniciado\n📂 RafaelAngelRamirez/documentos-vaticanos\n🌿 Rama: " + $("Nombre de la rama").item.json.branch_name }}

parameters.command:
set -euo pipefail
LOCK=/tmp/docvat-build.lock
exec 9>"$LOCK"
if ! flock -n 9; then
  echo "ERROR: another DOCVAT build holds $LOCK — abort to avoid volume corruption" >&2
  exit 75
fi
# Keep lock for the rest of this n8n execution by writing a marker; child docker run does not need the flock
echo "$$ $(date -Iseconds)" > /tmp/docvat-build.owner
# Nuclear clean of the shared n8n_build volume mounted at /tmp/repo
# (cannot rmdir the mountpoint; wipe all contents including .git)
if [[ -d /tmp/repo ]]; then
  # Prefer find (handles deep trees); fall back to rm
  find /tmp/repo -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -rf /tmp/repo/.[!.]* /tmp/repo/..?* 2>/dev/null || true
fi
mkdir -p /tmp/repo
# Prove pack path is writable
mkdir -p /tmp/repo/.git-write-test && rmdir /tmp/repo/.git-write-test
echo "clean ok; free: $(df -h /tmp/repo | tail -1)"

set -euo pipefail
LOCK=/tmp/docvat-build.lock
exec 9>"$LOCK"
if ! flock -n 9; then
  echo "ERROR: another DOCVAT build holds $LOCK" >&2
  exit 75
fi
echo "==> lock acquired $$"

BRANCH="${DOCVAT_BRANCH:-typescript-migration}"
if [[ -f /tmp/docvat-branch.txt ]]; then
  BRANCH=$(cat /tmp/docvat-branch.txt)
fi
# Isolate from Imperium files that share codice-progressio_n8n_build
WORKDIR=/tmp/repo/docvat
echo "==> WORKDIR=$WORKDIR branch=$BRANCH"
# Nuclear clean of ONLY the docvat subdir
rm -rf "$WORKDIR"
mkdir -p "$WORKDIR"
cd "$WORKDIR"

echo "==> clone"
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$BRANCH" \
  https://github.com/RafaelAngelRamirez/documentos-vaticanos.git .
test -f package.json
test -f scripts/package-apk.sh
test -f frontend/android/app/capacitor.build.gradle
echo "==> checkout $(git rev-parse --short HEAD) $(git log -1 --oneline)"

cat > "$WORKDIR/.ci-build.sh" <<'CIEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export HOME=/cache/gradle/.home_runner
mkdir -p "$HOME"
git config --global --add safe.directory /work
git config --global user.name "Mr. Nochon"
git config --global user.email "mr.nochon@codice-progressio.online"
cd /work
CURRENT_STAGE="iniciando"
notify_step(){ :; }; notify_done(){ :; }; notify_fail(){ :; }; notify_init(){ :; }
if [[ -f /work/scripts/notify-build.sh ]]; then
  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  source /work/scripts/notify-build.sh || true
  set -E
  trap 'notify_fail "$CURRENT_STAGE" 2>/dev/null || true' ERR
  notify_init "Documentos Vaticanos CI" 7 || true
fi
test -f /work/package.json
test -f /work/scripts/package-apk.sh
echo "==> [1/7] Dependencias"
CURRENT_STAGE="Dependencias"; notify_step "$CURRENT_STAGE" || true
if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then yarn install --production=false || true; fi
( cd frontend && (yarn install --production=false || npm ci || npm install) )
( cd backend && (yarn install --production=false || npm ci || npm install) || true )
echo "==> [2/7] Release"
CURRENT_STAGE="Release"; notify_step "$CURRENT_STAGE" || true
if [[ "${DV_SKIP_RELEASE:-0}" != "1" ]]; then
  npx standard-version || yarn standard-version || true
fi
VERSION="v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
echo "::DOCVAT_VERSION::${VERSION}"
echo "==> [3/7] Web"
CURRENT_STAGE="Web"; notify_step "$CURRENT_STAGE" || true
bash scripts/package-web.sh
echo "==> [4/7] APK"
CURRENT_STAGE="APK"; notify_step "$CURRENT_STAGE" || true
bash scripts/package-apk.sh
echo "==> [5/7] Electron linux+win"
CURRENT_STAGE="Electron"; notify_step "$CURRENT_STAGE" || true
export DV_ELECTRON_TARGETS=linux,win
export DV_REQUIRE_WIN=1
bash scripts/package-electron.sh
echo "==> [6/7] Collect downloads"
CURRENT_STAGE="Downloads"; notify_step "$CURRENT_STAGE" || true
export DV_REQUIRE_ALL_DOWNLOADS=1
bash scripts/package-collect-downloads.sh
echo "==> [7/7] Docker + deploy"
CURRENT_STAGE="Deploy"; notify_step "$CURRENT_STAGE" || true
bash scripts/ci-docker-push.sh
bash scripts/ci-deploy-docvat.sh
notify_done || true
echo "::DOCVAT_BUILD_DONE::${VERSION}"
CIEOF
chmod +x "$WORKDIR/.ci-build.sh"

if ! docker image inspect imperium-build-runner:latest >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: imperium-build-runner:latest missing" >&2
  exit 3
fi

SOCK_GID=$(stat -c %g /var/run/docker.sock)
echo "==> docker run sidecar (mount subdir /tmp/repo/docvat -> /work)"
docker run --rm --network codice-progressio_default --user 1000:1000 --group-add "$SOCK_GID" \
  -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
  -v codice-progressio_n8n_build:/tmp/repo \
  -v codice-progressio_n8n_android_sdk:/tmp/repo/docvat/frontend/.android-build-tools \
  -v codice-progressio_n8n_gradle:/cache/gradle \
  -v codice-progressio_n8n_electron:/cache/electron \
  -e HOME=/cache/gradle/.home_runner \
  -e GRADLE_USER_HOME=/cache/gradle \
  -e ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=/cache/electron \
  -e DOCKER_USERNAME="$DOCKER_USERNAME" \
  -e DOCKER_TOKEN="$DOCKER_TOKEN" \
  -e JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/temurin-21-jdk-amd64 \
  -e DV_SKIP_RELEASE=1 \
  -e DV_REQUIRE_WIN=1 \
  -e DV_REQUIRE_ALL_DOWNLOADS=1 \
  -e BUILD_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK=http://n8n:5678/webhook/build-progress \
  -w /tmp/repo/docvat \
  imperium-build-runner:latest bash /tmp/repo/docvat/.ci-build.sh
rc=$?
echo "==> build exit $rc"
exit $rc

cd /tmp/repo || exit 1
git config user.name "Mr. Nochon"
git config user.email "mr.nochon@codice-progressio.online"
# Do not commit multi-MB installers; only version files from standard-version
git add package.json frontend/package.json CHANGELOG.md frontend/CHANGELOG.md 2>/dev/null || true
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "main: sin cambios de versión que commitear"
else
  APP_VERSION="v$(node -p "require('/tmp/repo/package.json').version" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
  git commit -m "chore(release): ${APP_VERSION} [skip ci]"
  echo "main: commit de release creado"
fi

parameters.text:
={{ "✅ Documentos Vaticanos listo
Versión: " + $("Extraer versión").item.json.app_version + "
🌐 https://docvat.codice-progressio.online/
📦 /downloads APK + Electron Linux/Windows" }}
